body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-07-31 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "we are sticking to the 25% revenue guidance ... 25% is what the reasonable you can expect from the company over the next 2 to 3 years" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: ~25% p.a. FY26-FY28. Deadline: 2027-03-31 (first check FY27). Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: withdrawn. Evidence: FY27 guidance set at +15% (Apr-26), with an explanation: export disruption and weak FY26 inflow ('conservative guidance'). The 20-25% path was pushed to FY28. Explanation given: exports/Middle East, freight, low FY26 order intake (Apr-26, prompted by analyst)
